name: CustomerTicketSubmissionPage
title: Submit Support Ticket
description: Public-facing page where customers can submit new tickets, view submission guidelines, and access help resources. Displays the ticket submission form and provides real-time validation.

config.text: We're here to help! Please provide details about your issue and our support team will respond as soon as possible.

• Check our FAQ and knowledge base for quick answers
• Provide detailed information to help us resolve your issue faster
• Include screenshots or attachments if applicable
• You'll receive a ticket number to track your request

For urgent issues, please contact our support hotline:
📞 1-800-SUPPORT (24/7)
📧 urgent@support.com
After submission, you can track your ticket status on the tracking page.

name: CustomerTicketTrackingPage
title: My Support Tickets
description: Customer portal page displaying list of tickets submitted by the logged-in customer with current status, priority, assigned agent, and last update. Provides search, filter, and detail view capabilities.

config.text: Track and manage all your submitted support requests

config.placeholder: Search tickets by title or description...

emptyState.message: No tickets found. Submit your first support ticket to get started.

items.label: Overdue
